m01-tent.note: Patersonos at his tent in the south gully, looking upslope to the crown.

scene.prompt: Turn [image 1], a crude 3D blockout, into a photorealistic night photograph with the same camera and landforms. None of its surfaces survive: every smooth green lozenge becomes a real Italian cypress or maritime pine, every rounded blob a real maquis bush or limestone boulder, Hellenistic Greece. NIGHT under a full moon: deep blue-black sky, cold silver moonlight, exposed so every plane stays readable. The ruined wall on the skyline stays small and far off. [image 2] is a reference board: copy its man and objects exactly. In the clearing at lower centre: the board's low linen ridge tent, and beside it its bronze shield with the black trident, its plain wooden chest (closed) and its lidded wicker basket. The man from the board (thick red hair, full red beard, cream corslet, oxblood cloak, bronze greaves) sits alone at the tent mouth, still, watching. Deep focus, all sharp. No fire, lamp or glow; no other people; no buildings; nothing modern.

m03-raven.note: Lynchaia at her tent in the east gully, tying a message tube to a raven's leg.

scene.prompt: Turn [image 1], a rough 3D blockout, into a photorealistic night photograph with the same camera, composition and landforms. Replace its smooth placeholder shapes with real cypress, maritime pine and maquis in a wooded gully at the foot of a limestone hill, Hellenistic Greece. NIGHT under a full moon: deep blue-black sky, cold silver moonlight, no daylight colour, exposed so every plane stays readable. [image 2] is a reference board: copy its woman and objects exactly. In a small clearing in the foreground: the board's low linen ridge tent on two wooden poles, the board's bronze shield with the black boar leaning on it. The woman from the board (grey hair, quilted linen corslet, knee-length blue tunic, bronze greaves) kneels at the tent mouth tying the board's small bronze tube to the leg of the board's raven, held gently in her hands; the board's wicker basket beside her, lid open, empty. Deep focus, all sharp. No fire, lamp or glow; no other people; no buildings; nothing modern.

m11-dusk.note: At dusk on the crown: Lamportos inside the ring wall by the loot, giving the word; Shostakos outside it on the path by the gap, sandglass in hand, about to go down to his post.
